Wikipedia states: 'The term smartphone (as one lowercase word) was first used by Ericsson in 1997 to describe a new device concept, the GS88.' Multiple independent sources agree on 1997 Ericsson coinage; earlier forms (1980/1985/1987) used different capitalisations.

Wikipedia: IBM Simon prototype demonstrated November 1992 at COMDEX (first commercially referrable device), commercially released by BellSouth in 1994 as Simon Personal Communicator. The category is dated from this prototype. Partial precision: 1992-1994 interval.

Interval 2007-2012 is a reasonable emergence-to-tipping-point window; precise year of crossing into mass adoption is contested. Certainty moderate for the interval, lower for any precise crossing year.
